instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Share one post into a shared space as a member who counts there now, and answer the item row to store", and give it space (the space's id, the last part of its record:space row id); subject (this person, the way the space names them); idempotency_ref (a key that names this post, so asking again does not post it twice); fields (what the post says: for an event, title, about, starts_at and ends_at); records (the space's record:space row, this person's record:space-member row, and the record:space-item rows it shows).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:post-in-a-space and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read the answer: posted true means the item row under keep is stored by the caller; replay true means the post was already there and nothing is kept.
